summary: Tested redwork.ch full backend (25 pytest tests, 100% pass) and frontend admin + public pages. All critical flows working: admin login, sidebar nav (FAQ/Antwortvorlagen/Firmen/Produkte/Rechnungen/Offerten), companies CRUD, products CRUD, FAQ admin (500 rendered), invoice/offer editor with 'Aus Katalog' button, mobile responsive admin drawer, public FAQ section (987 entries) and Contact section with map.

issues: Username and password inputs have no name/id/data-testid attributes – makes E2E testing harder. Suggest adding data-testid='admin-username', 'admin-password', 'admin-login-submit'.
A black square overlay sits to the right of the OSM map iframe on desktop (visible in screenshot). May be a layout/iframe sizing issue – consider verifying iframe width/responsive container.

action_items: Add data-testid attributes to admin login inputs and submit button (admin-username, admin-password, admin-login-submit) for testability.
Investigate the black square overlay next to the contact map iframe on desktop view (homepage Kontakt section).
Optionally add data-testid attributes to sidebar nav items, invoice/offer editor fields, and product picker for more robust automation.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1184 lines – consider splitting into modules (auth, invoices, faqs, etc.) for maintainability (>700 lines threshold).
Backend uses snake_case in some places but API schema is camelCase – consistent and well documented via Pydantic; good.
PDF generation (qr_invoice.build_invoice_pdf / build_offer_pdf) returns valid %PDF bytes for both invoices and offers – no 500 errors observed.
SMTP send endpoint correctly returns ok=false (200) with 'SMTP not configured' – graceful degradation as expected.
FAQ admin caps render at 500 even though 987 are seeded – good for performance; ensure search filters across all 987 (server returns all, client filters).
